name: Agent Notifier
description:
Monitor local Codex and Claude Code sessions in the top bar, with activity previews, notification controls, and hide/restore actions.

Requires the separately installed Agent Notifier companion service and CLI hooks. Installation instructions: https://github.com/MrMohebi/agent-notifier#install

Clipboard access: writes a resume command to the clipboard only when you click Copy resume. It does not read clipboard contents or execute the command.
